title: What a Guest Decides in Their First Ten Seconds

scenes.say: A new guest walks in. Ten seconds later, she's already decided.

scenes.speaker: Priya
scenes.say: Hmm. Is this place any good?
In those first seconds she takes in the smell at the door. Whether the tables are clean. And the big one: whether anyone says hi.

scenes.speaker: Priya
scenes.say: Okay. Someone said hi. I'm staying.
Say hi in the first ten seconds. Follow for more cafe life.
